The Ewan Calder mysteries · Book One

LOT 27

A worthless picture. A missing lot. A secret buried for thirty-seven years.

When antiques runner Ewan Calder clears the home of a dead collector, one item has vanished from the inventory. Nobody agrees what it was. Someone has protected the truth for decades — and they are prepared to kill to keep it from coming under the hammer.
